references.name: Apple iOS 27 — native material
references.observation: Native toolbar with refracted wallpaper line; same-day earlier browser proof, not live native interaction.

references.name: Apple iPadOS 27 — native material
references.observation: Design refinements card with native control pill and edge highlight; 27 Preview, no release claim.

references.name: Apple macOS 27 — native material
references.observation: Focused material card and adjacent Mail toolbar/sidebar screenshot; 27 Preview.

references.name: Apple watchOS 27 — native material
references.observation: Control Center buttons and translucent Find My / Smart Stack imagery; material card right edge cropped.

references.name: Kube — interactive refraction playground
references.observation: Embedded playground visibly bends grid lines; surface selector interaction verified in earlier same-day run.

references.name: liquidGL — live lens demo
references.observation: Live lens visibly bends background and compresses text at edges; controls expanded in earlier same-day run.

references.name: rdev — Liquid Glass React demo
references.observation: Standard to Prominent alone inconclusive. Then keyboard Home/End set blur 0 and displacement 200: background visibly distorted and color-separated. No Safari/Firefox execution proof.

references.name: StarKnightt — pointer lens demo
references.observation: Pointer move and click produced changed lens position/shape and bent/magnified text. No measured timing/FPS or isolated ripple claim.

references.name: design.dev — frosted CSS comparison
references.observation: Functional scene-switching preview shows blur/tint/rim controls. Refraction not established; explicit comparison reference.

references.name: Aside — solid control alternative
references.observation: White opaque nav after scroll; sampled backdropFilter none. NOT actual refractive glass. Same-day prior measurements reused.
